notes: Verses 2-13 list what each house signifies; verses 14-16 give the general test of whether a house prospers or suffers, applied here to every house except the 8th (longevity, excluded by policy). The avastha (planetary state) and planetary-war conditions are not encoded yet.

rules.text: The 1st house is supported (a benefic or its own lord occupies or aspects it, and its lord is unafflicted): matters of the self — body, appearance, vigour and temperament prosper.

The 1st lord is afflicted (with malefics or the lords of the 6th, 8th or 12th, or placed in those houses) and the house has no benefic or own-lord support: matters of the self — body, appearance, vigour and temperament suffer losses.
The 2nd house is supported (a benefic or its own lord occupies or aspects it, and its lord is unafflicted): matters of wealth, family, food and speech prosper.

The 2nd lord is afflicted (with malefics or the lords of the 6th, 8th or 12th, or placed in those houses) and the house has no benefic or own-lord support: matters of wealth, family, food and speech suffer losses.
